title: Roadmap dependency cartography and cutover ruleset
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Problem: Cross-team roadmap handoffs are repeatedly blocked by ambiguous ownership and ad-hoc cutover rules. During quarter planning we surface >30 dependencies across Eng/Design/Security/Infra with inconsistent metadata (owner, gating criteria, rollout window). That increases coordination overhead and causes last-minute rollbacks during Dedicated and Private launch windows.

Goal: Build a lightweight dependency cartography (structured catalogue) plus a standardized cutover ruleset and gating checklist that is integrated into sprint planning and our release calendar. Deliverables: (1) a canonical dependency schema, (2) an automated snapshot export for the Console release board, (3) a cutover ruleset with canary windows/fallback policies, and (4) a short runbook for on-call and PMs.

Scope: Core cross-team product dependencies for all Redwood public releases and Dedicated/Private cutovers. Excludes one-off infra maintenance work unless it impacts a public cutover.

Constraints & trade-offs: We will prioritize clarity and low friction over exhaustive data capture. The schema should be minimal so teams will keep it updated. We accept that some dependencies will be weakly typed initially and be improved over two cycles. We will not attempt to fully automate ownership enforcement in this phase; enforcement remains a people/process responsibility with tooling nudges (calendar reminders, Console badge).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical dependency schema documented and published in Confluence
Exportable CSV/JSON snapshot for Console release board (fields: key, owner, team, gating_criteria, cutover_window, fallback_model, readiness_score)
Cutover ruleset published (canary windows, rollback triggers, fallback routing) and acknowledged by Eng, Design, Security, Infra leads
At least one pilot release uses the ruleset end-to-end without last-minute rollback caused by dependency mismatch
Runbook created for PMs/oncall and linked from release calendar entries

implementation_plan: Week 1: Finalize minimal schema and Confluence doc; circulate to Eng/Design/Security/Infra leads for signoff
Week 2: Build export script (Console backend) to produce snapshot CSV/JSON and wire to release board; create a small UI badge for 'readiness_score'
Week 3: Publish cutover ruleset and runbook; infra reserves canary window and PMs assign owners
Pilot week: Execute pilot cutover, collect telemetry (rollback events, coordination latency metrics), and run postmortem
Retro cycle: Iterate on schema and integrate small improvements into Console (badge visibility, calendar sync)
metrics: % of cross-team dependencies with an owner and cutover_window (target 90% for pilot)
Mean coordination latency (time between dependency change and owner acknowledgment) (target < 48h)
Number of last-minute rollbacks attributable to dependency mismatch (target 0 for pilot)
Readiness score correlation with rollout success (slope and threshold to be determined during pilot)
